#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end invocation test: mixed line kinds, ordering, exit code."""
import json, subprocess, sys
lines = []
lines.append(b'{"id":"ok1","version":1,"nodes":["A","B"],"edges":[],"commodities":[],"domains":[],"max_faults":0,"snapshots":[{"id":"s","bounds":[],"controller":[],"tolerance":0,"observations":[]}]}')
lines.append(b'not json at all')
lines.append(b'{"id":"bad","version":2}')
lines.append(b'')
lines.append(b'[1,2,3]')
lines.append(b'{"id":"NaNcase","tolerance":NaN}')
lines.append(json.dumps(json.load(open('/workspace/public/sanity.jsonl')).__class__ and {}) or b'{}')
# a real instance from sanity
sanity = [l.strip().encode() for l in open('/workspace/public/sanity.jsonl') if l.strip()]
lines.append(sanity[1])
data = b'\n'.join(lines)          # deliberately no trailing newline
r = subprocess.run(['/workspace/submission/run.sh'], input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/tmp' if False else '/')
print('returncode', r.returncode)
outs = r.stdout.splitlines()
print('lines out', len(outs), 'lines in', len(lines))
for i, o in enumerate(outs):
    d = json.loads(o)
    print(i, d.get('id'), d.get('status'), d.get('error'), d.get('min_faults'))
assert r.returncode == 0
assert len(outs) == len(lines), (len(outs), len(lines))
assert json.loads(outs[0])['status'] == 'unique'
for i in (1, 3, 5):
    assert json.loads(outs[i])['error'] == 'malformed_json', i
assert json.loads(outs[2])['error'] == 'invalid_instance' and json.loads(outs[2])['id'] == 'bad'
assert json.loads(outs[4])['error'] == 'invalid_instance' and json.loads(outs[4])['id'] is None
assert json.loads(outs[6])['error'] == 'invalid_instance' and json.loads(outs[6])['id'] is None
assert json.loads(outs[7])['id'] == 'repair' and json.loads(outs[7])['status'] == 'unique'
print('stderr bytes:', len(r.stderr))
print('E2E OK')
PYEOF
